name: Spur gear (parametric teeth & module)
description: A spur gear from params: teeth (default 20) and module_mm (default 2). The pitch radius is derived — module_mm*teeth/2/1000 metres — and drives both the visual disc and the mesh ratio automatically: mesh two parametric gears and the coupler ratio is teethA/teethB. Mount on a shaft via the bore; the gear connector is the mesh interface.
